title: Cane Adiss
caption: •Cane Adiss (V)
game_text: If opponent just Force drained at a non-battleground location (or at any location for more than 3 Force), deploy on that location. To initiate a Force drain at same or related location, opponent must first place a card from hand in Lost Pile. {control}
lore: Adventurous pilot. Boasts to Jabba that he has traveled to every uncharted planet in the galaxy. Has been hired by the Empire to keep an eye out for Rebel activity.
